title: Formalize support-changing relation layers and the Krylov boundary-control calculation
body:
## Owner-workbench continuation

Stacked on the checked PR #12 head `5d2772ea0a16d177ac3e01ff70394b90ba95a232`. The final compare contains **thirteen added files and no modified or deleted existing files**. The original scalar, prior mathematical modules, dependency pins, old workflows and other sessions' workbenches are unchanged. This remains a draft for review; nothing is merged or submitted to Sneed.

## Fresh validation — PASSED

**Verified implementation head:** `21970bbf4760d0bbca512a4a7996a2e38f968947`.

**[Successful push run 34705607593 / job 103584974563](https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/zeta-function-research-reader/actions/runs/34705607593/job/103584974563).** The completed job and its full log were read back. Every step concluded successfully.

The run installed the unchanged Lean **4.31.0**, verified Mathlib **`fabf563a7c95a166b8d7b6efca11c8b4dc9d911f`**, verified the original 7,366-byte SplitZero core, rebuilt the previous library, and rechecked the seven tau sources. Each of the **five new source files** then passed a separate `--trust=0 -DwarningAsError=true` invocation.

All **38 explicitly selected new declarations' transitive axiom reports** passed, containing only subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The prior **87-target tau**, **73-target derived**, and **28-target structural** audits passed again. Eighteen audit-harness tests passed both normally and under `python -O`. These test the checking machinery, not the mathematics; the mathematical execution evidence is Lean's successful checks. Declaration counts include definitions and infrastructure, not 38 discoveries.

The exact new source SHA-256 values printed by the successful run are:

```
78bd445b8efcde4e8e58bc489a574195f3606df9335eaeff659d0dac419343f7  SplitZeroBoundaryControl.lean
9149de8bbaaf132569b5b61ec9e07b058d5d295e8f9a305fd70651831191aa10  SplitZeroControlCompression.lean
9f4902c3376bc3c3b92e3eedb4a67ca6a05b06dc2a0cea1fd2e558a0a2f2d225  SplitZeroKrylovStep.lean
719da6c00cc0e9fd828bc53753980314e2a442c27cb96ccede84c80b4c9c0578  SplitZeroRelationLayer.lean
e245230b06d099fcf4c41948813a7f4d278379287506eca4293f28aa18957a26  SplitZeroSupportChange.lean
```

Development failures remain in the branch history. Their API, proof-script and linter issues were repaired before the successful run, without disabling strict checks or weakening the conclusions. Lean ran on GitHub Actions, not in the unavailable local authoring runtime. New modules are checked through the explicit added manifest; the prior Lake default targets were not silently changed.

## Completed formalizations

### Support-changing maps and actual relation quotients

`SplitZeroSupportChange.lean` constructs morphisms over a bottom-and-join-preserving support map. Coefficient maps obey naturality, and their total maps are genuine G(R)-linear maps on the original reconstructed carriers. Support, fibre-zero, composition and promotion-by-actual-transport formulas are proved. Arbitrary transports are not assumed injective.

`SplitZeroRelationLayer.lean` constructs `M/L ~= M intersect ker P` for a retraction P onto L, with explicit inverse. Its orthogonal instance uses Mathlib's actual `starProjection`. It constructs the original quotient transition `B/L -> B/M`, separately constructs the derivative between these types when `D L <= M`, and proves the retained-then-killed class criterion. The derivative is not incorrectly made an endomorphism of `B/L`.

### Derive boundary control from a finite Krylov stage

`SplitZeroBoundaryControl.lean` defines `R=(1-P)s`, `B=DR-RA`, and the sesquilinear control form from A and R. Green's identity and orthogonality yield `W=-(R*B+B*R)` and then the source's rank-two cross-pairing. The exact Gram downdate and the old quotient's derivative defect `-[u] r` are proved as well. The rank-two formula is a conclusion, not an assumed field of the input.

`SplitZeroKrylovStep.lean` proves the one-layer escape from `D f_j=f_(j+1)` and a finite expansion of `P s`. It constructs the next orthogonal residual vector, its original unscaled norm square and its inner-product row, and packages these into the preceding theorem's input. Thus the escape identity need not be postulated when instantiating the theorem from the finite raw columns.

The ambient inner-product space is not required complete. The derivative can therefore act on the original test-function space with its L2 inner product; the code does not impose an everywhere-defined unbounded derivative on all of L2.

### Rank and scalar compression

`SplitZeroControlCompression.lean` factors the derived control matrix through `Fin 2` and proves rank <= 2. It proves transfer of nonzero eigenvalues through the actual pair of linear maps, the compressed determinant, its real roots and their exact scalar symmetric radius. The complete generalized-eigenvalue/Loewner-norm identification remains a written connection, not an additional bundled Lean declaration.

## Source audit and additional written deductions

The owner's new 501-line orthogonal-boundary note is the mathematical source. The audit retains the reality condition needed for the exact 1/2 diagonal in its monic recurrence; Green's identity alone for a general complex seed fixes only its real part.

For reflection-stable packets with all multiplicities, trace invariance proves `Re(c_n)=0`, so the only possible nonzero normalized control eigenvalues are opposite. With `delta_n=det(G_(n+1))/det(G_n)`, the written determinant calculation gives

`delta_n=1-h_(n+1)b_n`,

`h_n a_n=delta_(n-1)^(-1)-1`,

and consequently the explicit relative-conditioning bound

`epsilon_n^2 <= (h_(n+1)/h_n)(delta_(n-1)^(-1)-1)(1-delta_n)`.

A separate analytic proof gives density of the actual theta Krylov span in L2 and the full positive Gram tail `G_n=sum_(j>n) h_j r_j* r_j`. The arithmetic quotient is not replaced by the L2 closure: the jet maps and original quotient remain on the test-function topology. These reflection, determinant and density arguments are written proofs, not part of the 38-target Lean certificate.

## Independent arithmetic-input evaluation

The supplied Wolfram Language script reproduces the first four unscaled theta norm squares from the actual incomplete-gamma double sum, at 65-digit working precision and integer cutoff 8:

```
1.279007247846485140479533592267...
13.055549302570558435392684658123...
250.008976819049914517451258753644...
6694.666685525627506773475623955402...
```

An independent written estimate proves that omitted integer terms contribute less than **1e-80 per exact raw 4-by-4 Gram entry** at that cutoff. Its sharper explicit expression evaluates to approximately 1.368e-92, but that decimal is not used as a rounding certificate. Floating-point rounding, Schur-complement error propagation and inverse-Gram error are not certified. The source's reported nineteen-test suite was not rerun; the exact CI harness tests and independent arithmetic evaluation are distinct records.

## Coordination and remaining interfaces

The metadata and handoff of the concurrently published PR #14 at `3bff1b2bd87dfa2592f65c5ccc231f6ee9541dfc` were read. Its density result and the one in our note are parallel derivations, not a claim of priority. No file on that branch was changed. Its full-jet constrained interpolation, CRT naturality, same-metric anti-linear reflection and total-degree multivariable extensions remain separately typed targets; reading the handoff is not their formal certification.

The concrete theta analyticity/range construction, integration by parts on its specific test spaces, all-n monic Gram-Schmidt recurrence, full support-changing homotopy for that specific chart, and a global small arithmetic excess remain separate instantiations or targets. No small-control conclusion is inferred merely from low rank or a decreasing Gram matrix.

Full proofs and exact source-to-Lean scope are in `workbenches/tau-boundary-layer-formal/RESEARCH_NOTE.md`. The numerical implementation and record are `check_theta_norms.wl` and `NUMERICAL_RECORD.json`; coordination is in `COORDINATION.md`. Only authored mathematics, code and validation records are published. No private transcript, external literature corpus, credentials or font files are republished.
